question: Should compute/green-compute move off fails-identity, and which identity kind does its self-serve sign-up need (email, card or crypto payment)?
why: The home page documents a free account with a USD 5 minimum top-up and a rental API at USD 0.40 per RTX 4090 hour billed per minute, so the earlier reading of no self-serve door no longer holds; the sign-up form fields could not be read without an account.
